meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会利用Cirq框架帮你设计、模拟和运行量子电路。它能生成Python代码，处理电路构建、噪声建模、参数扫描、硬件接口等任务，并给出运行结果或调试建议。
howto.when: 当你提到要使用Google量子硬件、设计含噪声电路，或运行量子表征实验时触发。其他Cirq相关的电路构建、模拟、噪声建模等任务也会协助。

say.text: 帮我用Cirq写一个两比特纠缠电路并模拟
say.note: 会生成电路代码和模拟结果

say.text: 用Cirq对参数做扫描，画出结果
say.note: 会给出参数扫描代码和可视化

say.text: 给这个电路加上退极化噪声模型
say.note: 会演示噪声建模与模拟

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the Cirq framework to help you design, simulate, and run quantum circuits. It can generate Python code for circuit construction, noise modeling, parameter sweeps, hardware access, and provide results or debugging advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention using Google quantum hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Also assists with other Cirq-related tasks like circuit building, simulation, and noise modeling.

say_en.text: Write a two-qubit entanglement circuit with Cirq and simulate it.
Run a parameter sweep with Cirq and plot the results.
Add a depolarizing noise model to this circuit.
say_en.note: Shows how to model and simulate noise.
